_fetch_method: MANUAL ONLY -- unlike tdcommons_leaderboard.json (partly) and polaris_leaderboard.json (fully), nothing in this file is live-fetched. prepare_moleculenet.py's scrape_leaderboard() is a deliberate no-op stub: moleculenet.org returned HTTP 404 on both its root and dataset pages when checked 2026-08-06 (looks rebuilt/repurposed, not the original DeepChem site), so there is currently nothing to scrape. Even if the site comes back, its 'leaderboard' is a fixed set of best-model numbers from one 2018 paper, not a live, growing leaderboard like TDC's or Polaris's -- there would be nothing new to re-fetch periodically. Update these values by hand (new paper, better score) and bump '_snapshot' if you do.
_comment: Curated fallback for MoleculeNet leaderboard metrics, used when scraping moleculenet.org fails. Values are representative best-model test scores from Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet, Chem. Sci.) and the DeepChem benchmark; treat as references, not ground truth. 'split' records the split MoleculeNet recommends/reports for that set (scaffold for BBBP/BACE/HIV, random for the rest). 'comparable': 'unverified' on every entry -- eosbench computes its own scaffold/random split for MoleculeNet families (see prepare_moleculenet.py) rather than honouring an official frozen split the way tdcommons/polaris do, and this hasn't been independently checked against Wu et al.'s own split the way the tdcommons/polaris one was (verified byte-for-byte); don't assume it's the same test set. Keyed by dataset family.
